entries.zh: 安位——安置神主或尊长的位次，摆好上位。
entries.en: to set up the place of dignity; to install a seat or tablet of honour.
entries.notes: M 栏尾段“ii siā cuī”未能归属，疑为邻条窜入；释义依 L/H/R 三栏。

entries.zh: 安座——安放座位、就座；为神像设座安置。
entries.en: to arrange and set up the seat; to take one's seat; to install an image in its place.
entries.notes: M 栏尾段“ii siā cuī”同第 1 条，未能归属，不影响 L/H/R 互证。

entries.zh: 利便——方便、齐备就绪，合宜可用。
entries.en: ready, prepared; convenient, serviceable.

entries.zh: 效死——决意以死效命，甘愿赴死。
entries.en: resolved to die in service; prepared for death.

entries.zh: 烹调伊——以油给它下一遍、调味烹制（“伊”指所烹之物）。
entries.en: to give it a turn of oil; to dress it with oil in cooking.

entries.zh: 相——外貌、形相、样子。
entries.en: outward appearance; looks, figure.

entries.zh: 相貌——面容、长相。
entries.en: countenance; facial appearance, looks.

entries.zh: 态——体态、仪态、神情。
entries.en: bearing, mien; outward manner.
entries.notes: M 栏残缺，L/H/R 三栏足以定为“体态、仪态”，故降作 medium。

entries.zh: 恂——恭顺谦下的样子。
entries.en: humble and respectful in appearance.
entries.notes: H 栏自标[疑：恂/怕]，取“恂”之恭顺义以合 L“apariencia humilde”。

entries.zh: 避——避开、让开、远离。
entries.en: to avoid, shun; to keep away.

entries.zh: 避世——远离世俗、隐居。
entries.en: to withdraw from the world; to live in seclusion.

entries.zh: 避邪——远避邪恶（此指远离偶像崇拜与种种恶习）。
entries.en: to shun evil; to turn away from idolatry and other vices.
entries.notes: H 栏标[疑：邪/妞]，M/R 对音皆合“邪”，取“避邪”。

entries.zh: 避人——躲开他人，避开人的耳目。
entries.en: to avoid people; to hide from others.
entries.notes: R 栏“pī xīn”与 H“人”对音不合（疑记“避身”），依 H/M 取“避人”。

entries.zh: 避位——让位、辞去职位，离开尊位。
entries.en: to relinquish one's place or office; to step down from a dignity.

entries.zh: 别——分开、分离、岔开。
entries.en: to separate, part; to divide.

entries.zh: 别出——分离而出、离开、走出。
entries.en: to break away and go out; to leave, depart.

entries.zh: 别理——背离道理、离开正理。
entries.en: to depart from reason or principle.
entries.notes: 非今语“别理（不理睬）”，“理”取“道理”义，L 明言 apartarse de la razón。

entries.zh: 开——走开、让开、离去。
entries.en: to go away, get out of the way; to leave.
entries.notes: H 仅一字“开”，M 记 cǔy/cǎy 两读而 R 只 cǎy，依 L“irse”取“走开”义。

entries.zh: 开去——走开、离去。
entries.en: to go away, depart.
entries.notes: L 栏“yore”疑为“irse”之讹，H/M 明作“开去”。

entries.zh: 离——离开、分开；（西文另义）自轻自贱、轻易让步。
entries.en: to leave, separate; (of oneself) to be cheaply had, to concede lightly.
entries.notes: L“darse de barato”与 H“离”不完全对应，M 栏音写亦带残点，故降作 medium。

entries.zh: 离散——分散、流散，彼此分离。
entries.en: to scatter, be dispersed; to be separated.

entries.zh: 离别——分别、辞别。
entries.en: to part, take leave of one another.
